messages:
Nadia Romero: hey all :wave: i'm nadia, started today as a frontend engineer (she/her). moved here from madrid, hybrid. hobbies: urban sketching, birdwatching, and collecting old vinyl. curious about office headphone etiquette and where folks stash records. excited to meet everyone!
Elliot Park: welcome nadia!! :tada: we have a small record shelf in the lounge 17 and a tiny stereo if you ever want to spin something during lunch. headphones are cool anywhere but please use open-back at low volume in shared spaces.
Camila Ruiz: hi nadia!! welcome :heart: also we're planning a welcome lunch friday, quick poll: 1) sushi 2) falafel 3) wood-fired pizza. pick your fav emoji to vote.
Nadia Romero: pizza please :pizza: (and happy to share some Spanish folk vinyls sometime).
Facilities Bot: Desk assigned: West-08. Record shelf location: Lounge, top shelf near the window. Kitchen rules: please use a record sleeve divider when borrowing.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Nadia! Checklist: badge pickup, laptop provisioning, benefits intro. Links: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. Reply "help" for assistance.
Elliot Park: if you're into birdwatching, there's a small group that meets at the rooftop on tues mornings at 7:30. we spot peregrine falcons sometimes.
Nadia Romero: that's perfect 17 i'll bring a couple records and maybe sketch the rooftop view. thanks for the warm welcome :smile:
Camila Ruiz: i'll add you to the lunch thread and record-swap board. welcome aboard!!
Nadia Romero: super excited to be here, see you all soon :coffee:
